AS programmable_rights, e.date_start::text AS date_start, (SELECT MIN(se.scanned_at)::text FROM tickets.scan_events se WHERE se.ticket_id = t.id) AS scanned_at, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), ?)
